faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: What you might want to know about kibouFlow

items.q: What kind of problems does this site mainly help with?
items.a: It mainly helps people who want to develop their career in Japan but lack clear direction — through hope sorting and path judgment. We don't give direct answers; instead, we help you organize your problems and suggest next steps.

items.q: Is this a tool, a service, or a platform?
items.a: Right now, it's more like an entry point that helps you sort out your needs and direction first. After sorting, we help you figure out what to do next. You don't need to understand everything upfront — just give it a try.

Anyone whose career direction in Japan is unclear, who doesn't know what to prioritize, or who has vague concerns they can't articulate well. As long as you're willing to sort things out, it's worth trying.
Issues requiring formal legal or financial opinions, highly complex disputes, and matters clearly outside our current scope. We'll be upfront about these.

Not right away. We first help you sort out your situation and needs. Only if it's genuinely appropriate will we suggest possible directions, including whether connecting with an organization makes sense.

items.q: Can I use this if my Japanese isn't great?
items.a: Yes. We support Chinese, Japanese, and English — use whichever language you're comfortable with. The initial sorting stage doesn't require strong Japanese skills.

items.q: Is there a cost right now?
items.a: The current sorting stage is free. If deeper services are needed later, we'll explain in advance. There are no hidden fees.

items.q: How is my submitted information handled?
items.a: Your information is used only for hope sorting and path judgment. It is not shared with third parties. We take your privacy seriously.
You'll receive feedback within 1–3 business days, including an initial assessment of your situation and suggested next steps. Whether to continue is entirely up to you.

items.q: How do I start a partnership?
items.a: Currently focused on small-scale pilots. Submit your interest through the partnership page, and we'll arrange a brief conversation to validate value starting from a pilot.
